findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.citation_text:
4-302.14 Staff recently started using quat tablets to prepare sani-buckets because bleach was irritating hands. Quat test kit was not available for checking sanitizer solutions. PIC placed an order during inspection for quat strips and will send inspector a photo once test kit is available for use at the facility. 
A test kit that accurately measures the concentration of sanitizing solutions in mg/L shall be provided.

findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting
findings.citation_text:
2-103.11 (O) Signed copies of reporting agreements were not available for kitchen staff at the time of inspection. Assistant director of food service noted paperwork for foodborne pathogens was signed at one point but was unable to locate documents. Employee health policy was discussed and documents were provided. Reporting agreements will be signed by all staff before the end of day. Ensure all staff that work in the kitchen have signed reporting agreements on file by next routine inspection. Volunteers are exempt from needing to have a reporting agreement on file but should still be educated on illness and when to refrain from coming in for shifts. Ensure all staff are educated on the employee health policy upon hiring and sign reporting agreements prior to beginning their first shift. Maintain signed copies of reporting agreements for staff.
The person in charge shall ensure that food employees are informed in a verifiable manner of their responsibility to report in accordance with law, to the person in charge, information about their health and activities as they relate to diseases that are transmissible through food, as specified under  2-201.11(A).

findings.title: Thermometers provided & accurate
findings.citation_text:
4-203.11 Two metal stem food thermometers were observed reading at 80F and 90F at room temperature. Ice point method was used to check thermometers for accuracy, with one thermometer reading between 44F-46F and the other around 34F. Thermometers were calibrated to 32F during inspection. Ensure thermometers are frequently checked for accuracy and calibrated.
Food temperature measuring devices that are scaled only in Fahrenheit shall be accurate to ±2F in the intended range of use.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
The food contact surface temperature of the dish machine ranged between 110F and 149F. Food contact surfaces must reach 160F when using water for sanitizing. Ensure the dish machine is fixed so food-contact surfaces are sanitized properly. Dishes will be sanitized in the 3 part sink until the dish machine is fixed. 

4-703.11: After cleaning, FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall be SANITIZED in: (A) manual hot water operations. (B) mechanical hot water operations. (C) Chemical manual or mechanical operations. Contact times shall be consistent with those on EPA-registered label use  standard contact time 30 seconds.
